items.why: A one-time property of the move PR's history: the reviewer checks that the move commit is R100 only (git show --name-status -M100% --format= <move commit>), that git diff -M --name-status origin/main...HEAD shows no A line for a file that existed under src/domain, src/lib or tests/fixtures and no D line for a core file, and that git log --follow reaches pre-move commits for gateway.ts, a domain file, a player file and a fixture.

A process state, settled by docs/specs/decisions-T2-02.md: the item applies to agent tasks that change repository code on main, so the owner's T0 spikes may stay in_progress. The reviewer checks node scripts/task.mjs list --status in_progress shows no other agent task and that the branch ships as one PR.
